title: Grade 2 French — Tue, Jun 17
description: Les vêtements — Day 2 of 5: Clothes vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'un t-shirt' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un t-shirt' = a t-shirt. The article 'un' is masculine. T-shirts are casual tops.

questions.question: What does 'un pantalon' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un pantalon' = trousers / pants. 'Je porte un pantalon.' = I wear trousers.

questions.question: What does 'une robe' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une robe' = a dress. 'Robe' is feminine (une). 'Elle porte une robe rouge.' = She wears a red dress.

questions.question: What does 'une jupe' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une jupe' = a skirt. 'Jupe' is feminine. 'Elle porte une jupe bleue.' = She wears a blue skirt.

questions.question: What does 'un manteau' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un manteau' = a coat. 'Il fait froid, je mets mon manteau.' = It is cold, I put on my coat.

questions.question: What does 'des chaussures' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Des chaussures' = shoes. 'Des' = some/a pair of (plural). 'Mes chaussures sont rouges.' = My shoes are red.

questions.question: What does 'une chemise' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une chemise' = a shirt (formal, with buttons). Different from a t-shirt which is casual.

questions.question: What does 'un pull / un pull-over' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un pull' = a sweater / jumper. 'Il fait froid — je mets un pull.' = It is cold — I put on a sweater.

questions.question: What does 'des chaussettes' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Des chaussettes' = socks. 'Mes chaussettes sont blanches.' = My socks are white.

questions.question: What does 'un chapeau' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un chapeau' = a hat. 'Il porte un grand chapeau.' = He wears a big hat.

questions.question: REVIEW from Day 1: What colour is 'rouge'?
questions.explanation: 'Rouge' = red. Combining Day 1 and Day 2: 'une robe rouge' = a red dress.

questions.question: REVIEW from Day 1: 'Une jupe verte' means:
questions.explanation: 'Verte' = green (feminine form of 'vert'). 'Une jupe verte' = a green skirt.

questions.question: Which word is masculine in French (uses 'un')?
questions.explanation: 'Un pantalon' is masculine. 'Robe', 'jupe', and 'chemise' are feminine (use 'une').

questions.question: In cold weather you might wear: 'un manteau' and 'un pull'. What are these?
questions.explanation: 'Un manteau' = a coat; 'un pull' = a sweater. Both are warm clothing for cold weather.

questions.question: Describe your school uniform: 'Je porte ___ et ___.' (I wear a white shirt and blue trousers.)
options: une chemise blanche et un pantalon bleu
un pantalon blanc et une chemise bleue
une robe blanche et une jupe bleue
un chapeau blanc et des chaussures bleues
questions.explanation: 'Je porte une chemise blanche et un pantalon bleu.' = I wear a white shirt and blue trousers. White shirt = chemise blanche (feminine); blue trousers = pantalon bleu (masculine).
